name: Near and far content
responsibility: Draws both readings of a card around one shared icon chip
description: paint_card_views uses shared_chip and moving_words from far_view.rs: the chip sits outside both word layers, and the words share their first baseline while moving and scaling. From far the chip grows into a tile at the top of the face, where it stands near, and the far words start level with it. A sequence participant uses the same card construction. paint_heading_views draws a flow heading without a chip. The SVG painter supplies the swap rules.
